adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` without applying any params or persisting anything; `@embedding` itself is an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding` from `EmbeddableHost.all`. On the client, `admin-embedding.js.es6#saveChanges` calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, which would hit the new `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` route via the new adapter and receive 200 with the same serialized payload. However, the template `embedding.hbs` doesn’t wire `saveChanges`, and host changes are persisted through `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (`host.save` / `destroyRecord`). So it’s a real, diff-grounded semantics/architecture issue (a no-op PUT endpoint + unused action), but not a currently verifiable broken behavior in the shipped UI.
